latestVersion.changelog:
claw-relay 1.0.0

- Initial release of claw-relay.
- Enables routing AI agent traffic through a residential IP using Tailscale exit nodes (WireGuard tunnel) — no custom relay or proxy required.
- Provides setup instructions for both Residential Node (exit node) and Cloud Node (VPS).
- Includes troubleshooting steps, architecture overview, and advanced options for ACLs and self-hosting with Headscale.
- No changes to agent code required; network routing is fully transparent.
